text:
Type: children's two-step stool
Use: helping a child reach a sink, shelf or bed, extra low seat; children's room, bathroom, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: solid wood with a painted lacquer finish, cut-out handles
Colors: bright cherry red
Shape: two stepped treads between curved side panels with oval hand holds, arched cut-out feet, sturdy and compact
Feel: cheerful, sturdy, playful, practical
Goes with: white walls, light wood, primary colors; playful children's rooms and family bathrooms

product.name: TROGEN
product.description: Your child can use it as a footrest, a seat or stand on it to reach things that are stored higher up.
